fix(release): build single arch per runner and merge mac update manifest

The mac/win targets in electron-builder.yml had `arch:` arrays that the
matrix CLI flags (`--mac --arm64` / `--mac --x64` / `--win --x64`)
didn't filter — every macOS runner ended up packaging both arm64 and
x64, doubling build time and producing per-arch `latest-mac.yml` files
that fought each other in the upload step.

Removing the YAML arch list lets the matrix flag decide. Because each
runner now produces an arch-specific `latest-mac.yml` that only lists
its own files entry, `upload-assets` downloads the artifacts unmerged
and combines the per-runner `latest-mac.yml` `files:` arrays into a
single manifest so electron-updater can resolve updates for either
architecture.

fix(ui): make LiveWaveform sizing transform-independent

LiveWaveform measured itself with getBoundingClientRect(), which includes
ancestor CSS transforms. When mounted inside a framer-motion <motion.div
layout> parent (e.g. the float listening pill), the FLIP layout animation
applies a scaleX transform that inflated the measured width. The inflated
value was written to canvas.style.width as an inline style and persisted
after the animation completed, leaving the canvas at varying widths.

Switch to transform-independent layout dimensions: entry.contentRect in the
ResizeObserver callback, and clientWidth/clientHeight in the animate and
animateProcessing loops.

fix(history): strip iconDataUrl from persisted records to unblock main thread

Each post-recording pipeline call was performing 6+ synchronous
electron-store.set('voiceHistory', ...) writes, each one a writeFileSync
of the entire ~44 MB store. With the user's local store at 249 records
× ~175 KB each, that meant ~1–1.5 s of main-thread blocking per
recording — long enough for uiohook-napi's CGEventTap to time out and
for the cursor + window dragging to freeze, even though the providers
themselves now run in a utility process.

The bloat was AppIdentity.iconDataUrl (base64 PNG) embedded in
record.debug.frontmostAppSnapshot and record.debug.delivery.targetAppAt*.
The renderer never reads those icons from history; only the live
floating-window UI does, against the listening session's targetApp.

Strip iconDataUrl at the persistence boundary inside HistoryRepository:
- New writes go through normalizeDebugData / normalizeDeliveryDebug,
  which now sanitize via stripAppIcon.
- Existing oversized records are migrated on the next read() — the
  existing mutated-flag rewrite path picks them up automatically, so
  the 44 MB store collapses to <1 MB on next access.

feat: provider platform refactor + local ASR model management end-to-end

# Provider platform refactor

- Unify LLM/ASR registries via a shared `ProviderRegistry<TDescriptor, TProvider>`
  base (register/resolve/get/evict/listDescriptors/disposeAll) — LLM keeps
  middleware, ASR keeps kind filtering / streaming detection.
- Make `resolve(id, config)` config-aware: cache key includes a stable hash of
  the validated config, so changing a config field disposes the old instance
  and rebuilds with the new one. The desktop runtime no longer needs to call
  `evict()` manually before every `resolve()`.
- Compose middleware once at resolve-time instead of rebuilding the chain on
  every property access; the proxy still binds `this.complete()` self-calls
  inside `generate()` to the wrapped chain.
- Drop the legacy function-style `LegacyLLMMiddleware`; converge on the
  hooks-object form (`{ wrapGenerate?, wrapComplete? }`).
- `OpenAIResponseShapeError` joins the `ProviderError` hierarchy; the
  hard-coded `[voice-debug]` console logs come out of the LLM provider.
- Sherpa-only manifest is split into architectures (recognizer config builder
  + file discovery) and pure-data manifest entries; catalog grew 2 → 9 popular
  streaming models without code changes (English mobile/full, multiple
  Chinese variants, French, Korean, paraformer bilingual + trilingual).
- Shared utilities: `AsyncPushQueue`, audio helpers (`assertPCMInput`,
  `normalizeAudioChunks`, `throwIfAborted`), `stableCacheKey`. Deepgram and
  sherpa-onnx providers reuse them.

# Local ASR model management

- New `LocalASRProvider` lifecycle (no-arg methods that take the modelDir
  from construction state): `listCatalogModels`, `scanInstalledModels`,
  `installModel`, `removeInstalledModel`, `resolveModelRuntime`.
- New `local-model-select` settings primitive — descriptors that declare it
  get a custom UI panel instead of a generic select.
- Sherpa-onnx descriptor moves to a `createSherpaOnnxDescriptor({
  defaultModelDir })` factory so the desktop main can inject
  `<userData>/asr-models/sherpa-onnx` after `app.whenReady()`. The connect
  dialog no longer surfaces a model-directory field; advanced users can
  override it from settings.
- Real install: streamed download (`https.get().pipe(createWriteStream)`)
  with archive integrity verification (sha256 when present in the manifest,
  byte-count fallback against `sizeBytes` otherwise), `tar -xjf` extraction
  to a `*.staging` path, file validation per architecture, then atomic
  rename. Cleans up archive + staging on cancel/error.
- New `providers.localModels.*` tRPC sub-router (getState / select / install
  subscription / cancelInstall / remove / changeDirectory). One in-flight
  install per provider, AbortController routed back from renderer
  cancellation.
- Runtime tightening: `resolveActiveASRSelection` rejects when a local ASR
  provider has no installed `selectedModelId`. The pipeline forwards
  `selectedModelId` from settings as `RecognitionOptions.modelId`.
- Renderer: single-path connect dialog (catalog + locale-aware Recommended
  highlight + streamed install progress + cancel), settings panel with
  installed-model switching / catalog install / remove / Advanced model-dir
  override. Both panels constrain dialog height to 85vh and scroll their
  lists internally.

# Streaming recognition correctness fixes

- Recognizer config now uses sherpa-onnx-node's flat endpoint fields
  (`rule1MinTrailingSilence` etc.) + explicit `decodingMethod: 'greedy_search'`;
  the previously-nested `endpointConfig` was silently ignored.
- Append 0.5s of silence before `inputFinished()` so the streaming model
  flushes; emit a synthetic final segment at end-of-stream when no endpoint
  fired (covered by a regression test).
- `sherpa-onnx-node` and its platform-specific siblings move to the main
  build's external list so Vite stops trying to bundle the native module.
- Replace the catch-all "native module not available" error with the real
  underlying load failure.

# Dev tooling

- `pnpm --filter @openbroca/providers sherpa:hash <id>` — streams an archive
  and prints its sha256 so users can upgrade a manifest entry to strict
  verification.
- `pnpm --filter @openbroca/providers sherpa:smoke <wav>` — loads a sherpa
  model with the production recognizer config and a real WAV; for diagnosing
  recognition issues without spinning up Electron.
